description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Joe Milton III signed with the Eagles on Friday.
items.impact: Milton has been on the Cowboys' practice squad all season to this point. The sixth-round draft pick from 2024 appeared in four games for the Cowboys last season, completing 15 of 24 passes for 183 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions. Milton brings some dual-threat potential, as he also rushed for 50 yards on five carries last season. With Jalen Hurts' health status completely up in the air due to a blood clot in his calf, the Eagles now have a QB trio consisting of Milton along with Sunday's presumed starter Tanner McKee and rookie Cole Payton.
items.title: Joe Milton III signs with Eagles

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) will return for the Jets on Sunday against the Patriots.
items.impact: Cooper has not played since he was knocked out of the Jets' season opener with a sprained ankle. The first-round rookie has returned to limited practice sessions this week, and it was announced Friday morning that he's ready for in-game action. With Adonai Mitchell (finger) remaining out this week, Cooper should slot right in behind Garrett Wilson at wide receiver for the Jets. However, there is certainly a chance that Cooper is eased back into the mix as far as total snaps go.
items.title: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) to return in Week 6

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell (finger) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Mitchell will miss his fourth consecutive game this week. Rookie first-rounder Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle), veteran Tim Patrick, and Isaiah Williams should slot in behind Garrett Wilson in the WR pecking order for the Jets on Sunday.
items.title: Adonai Mitchell (finger) out for Week 6

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Breece Hall (quad) will not play in Sunday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Hall will miss a third straight game due to a quad injury. Braelon Allen will shoulder the load out of the Jets' backfield once again in Week 6.
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) officially ruled out for Week 6

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Kenyon Sadiq (concussion) practices in full Friday.
items.impact: Sadiq looks to be finishing up his time in the league's concussion protocol on Friday. The rookie tight end is expected to play Sunday against the Patriots.
items.title: Kenyon Sadiq (concussion) looks good to go for Week 6

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: A.J. Brown (ankle) is trending toward playing on Sunday against the Jets.
items.impact: Brown has gotten in limited practice sessions each of the last two days. He has not played since being knocked out of the season opener due to a high-ankle sprain.
items.title: A.J. Brown (ankle) trending toward playing in Week 6

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Darius Slayton was released by the Colts on Friday.
items.impact: After being released by the Giants just before the season began, Slayton signed with the Colts in late September. The veteran receiver never got into a game for the Colts and has now been cut loose again. Slayton will now try to find another new team.
items.title: Darius Slayton released by Colts

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Eric Murray (concussion) is trending toward being active for Sunday's game against the Texans.
items.impact: Head coach Liam Coen said Friday morning that he feels "more confident" about Murray being able to play in Week 6. Murray missed Week 5's win against the Eagles. If he cannot go Sunday, Rayuan Lane would be in line to start again.
items.title: Eric Murray (concussion) trending toward playing Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans opened the practice window of Henry To'oTo'o.
items.impact: To'oTo'o will have 21 days to officially be activated by Houston.
items.title: Henry To'oTo'o (shoulder) has practice window opened

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants signed OL Josh Gesky to the practice squad.
items.impact: Gesky will add depth on the offensive line for the Giants.
items.title: Josh Gesky signs with Giants

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cardinals promoted TE Shawn Bowman to their 53-man roster.
items.impact: Bowman will add depth in the tight end room for Arizona.
items.title: Shawn Bowman promoted to 53-man roster

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cardinals opened the practice window of Kitan Crawford.
items.impact: Crawford will have 21 days to officially be activated.
items.title: Kitan Crawford (ankle) has practice window opened

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks moved WR Irvin Charles to their practice squad.
items.impact: Charles was activated from injured reserve this week.
items.title: Irvin Charles moved to Seahawks practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks signed RB Velus Jones Jr. to their 53-man roster.
items.impact: Jones will add depth in the backfield for Seattle.
items.title: Velus Jones Jr. signs with Seahawks 53-man roster

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The NFL has reduced Rams LT Alaric Jackson's two-game suspension to one game.
items.impact: Jackson will only miss Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
items.title: Alaric Jackson has suspension reduced to one game

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said Demarcus Robinson will not return before the bye in Week 8.
items.impact: Robinson remains off the fantasy radar.
items.title: Demarcus Robinson (ankle) will not return before bye week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said Deebo Samuel would be an IR consideration but they're going to hold off because of the bye in Week 8.
items.impact: Samuel will likely remain sidelined through the bye week for San Francisco. He is week-to-week.
items.title: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) expected to avoid IR

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Brenen Thompson (quad) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: To no surprise, Thompson was again limited on Thursday as he continues to manage a quad injury. If he plays in Week 6, he may see more opportunities than usual with Ladd McConkey (foot) and Quentin Johnston (chest) uncertain to play against the Chiefs.
items.title: Brenen Thompson (quad) limited again Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Marquez Valdes-Scantling (rib) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday after being limited on Wednesday due to a rib injury. He should play in Week 6 and will see more work than usual with the high number of injuries that Los Angeles is dealing with to their wideouts right now.
items.title: Marquez Valdes-Scantling (rib) upgraded to full participant Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: KeAndre Lambert-Smith (hamstring) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Lambert-Smith continues to work his way back from a hamstring injury and was limited at practice again on Thursday. He remains off of the fantasy radar moving forward, however.
items.title: KeAndre Lambert-Smith (hamstring) limited Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Charlie Kolar (arm) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran tight end practiced in a full capacity for a second-straight day on Thursday, indicating that he's nearly fully healthy at this point. He should play in Week 6 but doesn't project to be fantasy relevant moving forward.
items.title: Charlie Kolar (arm) practices in full Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Derwin James Jr. (hamstring) was absent from another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: James wasn't able to practice on Thursday, making it unlikely that he will suit up and play in Week 6. Los Angeles' secondary will be significantly weaker if he's ruled out for this matchup against the Chiefs.
items.title: Derwin James Jr. (hamstring) absent from practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Quentin Johnston (chest) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Johnston's chest injury continues to linger and left him limited for another practice session on Thursday. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect much production out of him this week, even if he's cleared to play heading into the weekend.
items.title: Quentin Johnston (chest) listed as limited Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Tre' Harris (hamstring) missed Los Angeles' practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Harris wasn't able to practice on Thursday due to a hamstring injury, which left him sidelined on Wednesday as well. It looks like he's trending towards being sidelined in Week 6, which is bad news for the Chargers with Ladd McConkey (foot) also uncertain to play.
items.title: Tre' Harris (hamstring) misses practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Ladd McConkey (foot) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: McConkey was limited for another practice on Thursday, which comes as no surprise, considering that he is uncertain to play in Week 6 due to his foot issue. Friday's injury report should tell us much more about his official injury status heading into the weekend.
items.title: Ladd McConkey (foot) limited again Thursday
